text:
anya: kicking off a small canary for rwd-encoder-v2-quant8 on dedicated-canary pool now. starting at 3% traffic, plan to ramp to 20% over 40m. watching quality + latency closely.

mike: what gates are we using for auto-pause/rollback?

anya: current gates: quality delta on evalset-main > 1.5% (abs), p95 latency increase > 200ms, error rate > 0.75% -> pause. rollback if pause + manual negative A/B. fallback rule: route to fp16 variant automatically if p95 > 350ms for >5m.

sophi: quick A/B run on 5k prompts: quant8 vs fp16 baseline. quality (exact-match) -1.1% relative, avg latency -34%, p95 -160ms. small regression but still within 1.5% gate.

dev-eval-bot: eval job 1769804401 completed. metrics: {"quality_delta":"-1.1%","latency_avg":"-34%","p95_delta":"-160ms","errors":"0.12%"} :white_check_mark:

mike: audible — can we tighten the quality gate for this workload? those prompts are high-precision. maybe 1.0% instead of 1.5% for this customer cohort.

anya: noted. updating canary policy to: quality gate 1.0% for cohort=payments, keep 1.5% global. applying change now.

deploy-bot: canary rollout: rwd-encoder-v2-quant8 -> staged 3% -> health: OK (30s) :rocket:

ops: FYI: watch KV cache hit rate — quant path reduces mem pressure but we saw an increase in cache misses in previous run due to chunking differences.

anya: good catch. dev-eval ran cache-profile and saw miss-rate +2.5pp on long-context tests. adding a cache-warmup step to canary and gating on cache_miss_delta <= 3pp.

sophi: re-run A/B with chatty long-context set (2k tokens): quality delta -0.9%, cache_miss +1.8pp, p95 latency -220ms. looks acceptable under tightened gates.

mike: what about fallback thresholds? auto-fallback to fp16 variant should be conservative. current rule: if p95 quant > fp16 p95 + 150ms for 5m -> fallback. good?

anya: yes, that's live. also configured alert: if rollout paused 3x in 24h -> auto rollback and open ticket to eng-ml.

dev-eval-bot: stress-test started 1769805120: qps spike to 3x for 10m to validate throttling and autoscale.

deploy-bot: canary ramp: 3% -> 8% -> health checks OK. metrics snapshot: quality_delta -1.0%, p95 -180ms, errors 0.14%, cache_miss +1.7pp.

mike: looks good to me for non-payments cohorts. for payments we hold at 3% until further manual review.

anya: agreed. manual hold for cohort=payments. continuing ramp for rest to 20% over next 30m. will post final A/B summary and perf traces.

ops: if anything trips the auto-pause I'll @channel and attach the canary trace link.

anya: thanks — keeping an eye. tagging @sophi for final quality sign-off before full rollout. :thumbsup:
